title: Application of Boston Edison Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, sec. 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly fuel charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings on the billing months of May, June and July of 1988, The fuel charge reflects changes in the prudently incurred, reasonable cost of fuels and power purchased by the Company.
